summary: Novo Nordisk filed a routine Form 6-K disclosing a PDMR share transaction under Article 19 of the EU Market Abuse Regulation, the standard non-US equivalent of a Section 16/Form 4 insider report. Executive Vice President, R&D and Chief Scientific Officer Martin Holst Lange sold 12,000 Novo Nordisk B shares (ISIN DK0062498333) at DKK 285.00 per share, an aggregate of DKK 3,420,000, on 2026-11-04 on Nasdaq Copenhagen. No board recommendation, advisor, ownership shift, strategic action, or deal mechanics are present; the filing carries no special-situations or risk-arb angle.
